mergewith.subtemplate:
<!-- Parameters. branchRates has the Real domain: with nonCentered="true" it holds N(0,1) deviates. --> <parameter id="MTSMclockRate.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" name="stateNode">1.0</parameter> <parameter id="MTSMclockSD.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" name="stateNode">0.5</parameter> <parameter id="MTSMbranchRates.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealVectorParam" domain="Real" name="stateNode" dimension="1">1.0</parameter> <parameter id="MTSMspikeMean.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealVectorParam" domain="PositiveReal" name="stateNode" dimension="1">0.01</parameter> <parameter id="MTSMspikeMeanPriorMean.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" name="stateNode" estimate="false">0.01</parameter> <parameter id="MTSMspikeShape.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealVectorParam" domain="PositiveReal" name="stateNode" dimension="1">2.0</parameter> <parameter id="MTSMlatentSpikes.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealVectorParam" domain="NonNegativeReal" name="stateNode" dimension="1">1.0</parameter> <parameter id="MTSMindicator.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.BoolVectorParam" name="stateNode" estimate="false" dimension="1">true</parameter>
<!-- Clock model --> <branchRateModel id="MultiTypeSpikeClock.c:$(n)" spec="multitypespike.clockmodel.PunctuatedClockModel" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" clock.rate="@MTSMclockRate.c:$(n)" rates="@MTSMbranchRates.c:$(n)" rateSD="@MTSMclockSD.c:$(n)" spikes="@MTSMlatentSpikes.c:$(n)" spikeMean="@MTSMspikeMean.c:$(n)" indicator="@MTSMindicator.c:$(n)" relaxed="true"/>
<!-- Spike prior; linked to the BDMM-Prime tree prior by the bdmDistr connector below --> <distribution id="MTSMbranchSpikePrior.c:$(n)" spec="multitypespike.distribution.BranchSpikePrior" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" spikes="@MTSMlatentSpikes.c:$(n)" spikeShape="@MTSMspikeShape.c:$(n)"/>
<!-- Priors --> <distribution id="MTSMclockRatePrior.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.Gamma" param="@MTSMclockRate.c:$(n)"> <alpha spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" value="10" estimate="false"/> <theta spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" value="0.01" estimate="false"/> </distribution> <distribution id="MTSMclockSDPrior.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.Gamma" param="@MTSMclockSD.c:$(n)"> <alpha spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" value="5" estimate="false"/> <theta spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" value="0.05" estimate="false"/> </distribution> <!-- Exactly one branch-rate prior is used, depending on nonCentered. The centred mean stays 1 for identifiability against the clock rate. --> <distribution id="MTSMbranchRatePriorCentered.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.IID" param="@MTSMbranchRates.c:$(n)"> <distr spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.LogNormal" meanInRealSpace="true"> <M spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" value="1" estimate="false"/> <S idref="MTSMclockSD.c:$(n)"/> </distr> </distribution> <distribution id="MTSMbranchRatePriorNonCentered.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.IID" param="@MTSMbranchRates.c:$(n)"> <distr spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.Normal"> <mean spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real" value="0" estimate="false"/> <sigma spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" value="1" estimate="false"/> </distr> </distribution> <distribution id="MTSMspikeMeanPrior.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.IID" param="@MTSMspikeMean.c:$(n)"> <distr spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.LogNormal" meanInRealSpace="true"> <M idref="MTSMspikeMeanPriorMean.c:$(n)"/> <S spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" value="0.6" estimate="false"/> </distr> </distribution> <distribution id="MTSMspikeMeanPriorMeanPrior.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.Exponential" param="@MTSMspikeMeanPriorMean.c:$(n)"> <mean spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" value="0.01" estimate="false"/> </distribution> <distribution id="MTSMspikeShapePrior.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.IID" param="@MTSMspikeShape.c:$(n)"> <distr spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.LogNormal" meanInRealSpace="true"> <M spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" value="2" estimate="false"/> <S spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" value="0.5" estimate="false"/> </distr> </distribution>
<!-- Spike operators --> <operator id="MTSMSpikeFlipOperator.c:$(n)" spec="multitypespike.operator.SpikeFlipOperator" spikes="@MTSMlatentSpikes.c:$(n)" spikeShape="@MTSMspikeShape.c:$(n)" branchSpikePrior="@MTSMbranchSpikePrior.c:$(n)" weight="30.0"/> <operator id="MTSMTargetedSpikeOperator.c:$(n)" spec="multitypespike.operator.TargetedSpikeOperator" spikes="@MTSMlatentSpikes.c:$(n)" branchSpikePrior="@MTSMbranchSpikePrior.c:$(n)" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" weight="10.0"/> <!-- Assumes positive rate multipliers, so only used when nonCentered="false" --> <operator id="MTSMSpikeUpRateDown.c:$(n)" spec="multitypespike.operator.SpikeUpDownOperator" parameter="@MTSMbranchRates.c:$(n)" spikes="@MTSMlatentSpikes.c:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.1" weight="20.0"/> <operator id="MTSMlatentSpikesScale.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator" parameter="@MTSMlatentSpikes.c:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.1" weight="30.0"/>
<!-- Parameter operators --> <operator id="MTSMclockRateScale.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator" parameter="@MTSMclockRate.c:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.1" weight="5.0"/> <operator id="MTSMclockSDScale.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator" parameter="@MTSMclockSD.c:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.1" weight="5.0"/> <operator id="MTSMspikeMeanScale.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator" parameter="@MTSMspikeMean.c:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.1" weight="10.0"/> <operator id="MTSMspikeMeanPriorMeanScale.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator" parameter="@MTSMspikeMeanPriorMean.c:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.1" weight="5.0"/> <operator id="MTSMspikeShapeScale.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator" parameter="@MTSMspikeShape.c:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.1" weight="10.0"/> <operator id="MTSMBitFlipOperator.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.BitFlipOperator" uniform="true" parameter="@MTSMindicator.c:$(n)" weight="1.0"/>
<!-- Branch-rate operators; the scale operator is added below only when nonCentered="false" --> <operator id="MTSMAdaptableOperatorSamplerRatesInternal.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.evolution.operator.AdaptableOperatorSampler" weight="20.0"> <parameter idref="MTSMbranchRates.c:$(n)"/> <tree idref="Tree.t:$(n)"/> <operator id="MTSMORCRatesRandomWalk.c:tree.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.RealRandomWalkOperator" parameter="@MTSMbranchRates.c:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.1" weight="1.0"/> </operator> <operator id="MTSMORCRatesScale.c:tree.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator" parameter="@MTSMbranchRates.c:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.5" upper="10.0" weight="1.0"/>
<!-- Loggers --> <log id="MTSMrateStat.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.evolution.RateStatistic" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" branchratemodel="@MultiTypeSpikeClock.c:$(n)"/> <log id="MTSMSaltativeProportionLogger.c:$(n)" spec="multitypespike.logger.SaltativeProportionLogger" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" clock="@MultiTypeSpikeClock.c:$(n)"/> <log id="MTSMSpikeLogger.c:$(n)" spec="multitypespike.logger.SpikeLogger" clock="@MultiTypeSpikeClock.c:$(n)"/> <log id="MTSMHiddenEventsLogger.c:$(n)" spec="multitypespike.logger.HiddenEventsLogger" branchSpikePrior="@MTSMbranchSpikePrior.c:$(n)"/>
Spike prior of partition c:$(n)
Mean clock rate of partition c:$(n)
Relaxed clock standard deviation of partition c:$(n)
Branch rate multipliers of partition c:$(n)
Non-centred branch rates of partition c:$(n); must remain Normal(0,1)
Spike mean of partition c:$(n)
Hyperprior on the prior mean of the spike mean of partition c:$(n)

Scale branch rates up and spikes down on a branch of partition c:$(n)
